settings.language.label: User interface language
settings.auto_device_detection_help: Automatically detects newly connected or disconnected devices in the background, without needing to click 'Refresh devices'. Disabling this stops periodic scanning.
settings.start_with_windows_help: Automatically starts Virtual Controller when you sign in to Windows.
settings.start_minimized_help: Opens the main window minimized at startup. This option is available only when starting with Windows is enabled.
settings.always_on_top_help: Keeps the app window above other windows. Enabled by default.
settings.more_coming: Additional global settings will be added here.
header.gamecontrollers_tooltip: Opens the native Windows Game Controllers control panel (joy.cpl).
mapping.name: Name:
mapping.layout_locked_tooltip: The layout cannot be changed while the controller is running. Stop it first.
mapping.hidhide_tooltip: Block this controller's physical devices from other applications while it is running (requires the HidHide driver).
mapping.auto_start_tooltip: Automatically starts and stops this controller based on whether the selected program is running.
mapping.assign_tooltip: Choose a physical input from a list instead of pressing or moving it.
mapping.notify_mode_change: Show on-screen notification when mode changes
mapping.active_mode_tooltip: Green = this is the controller's currently active mode.
mapping.disabled_mode_tooltip: Disabled modes are skipped when toggling or switching.
mapping.directional_tooltip: Apply only the captured half of the axis (e.g. Y+) to this target axis instead of the full axis. This allows the two halves of a physical axis to be mapped to different virtual axes.
mapping.assigned_disconnected_tooltip: Assigned to this controller, but currently disconnected.
devices.description: Disabled devices no longer appear in device selection lists. Disabled inputs are ignored during capture and mapping, but remain visible here. Use 'Hide' to remove a device (for example, a virtual controller created by this app) from the list; hidden devices can be shown again below.
devices.status_tooltip: Green = enabled and connected. Gray = disabled and/or disconnected.
devices.hide_tooltip: Permanently hide this device from the list (e.g. a virtual controller); it can be shown again below at any time.
devices.benchmark_tooltip: Opens a window with start/stop controls and continuously updated hardware benchmark metrics (polling rate, latency, reliability, signal).
devices.enable_axis_tooltip: Enable or disable the complete axis (both directions)
devices.enable_stick_tooltip: Enable or disable the complete stick
updates.auto_check_help: Automatically checks for a newer version each time the app starts. A missing internet connection does not affect the app.
updates.include_prereleases_help: Includes versions marked as prereleases (e.g. tags with the '-alpha', '-beta', or '-nightly' suffix) when checking for updates, in addition to stable releases.
updates.change_version_help: Switch to any available version, including older versions (rollback).
updates.open_log_help: Opens the update log (download, copying new files, restart) to help diagnose unexpected update behavior.
updates.open_appdata_help: Opens the application data folder (%AppData%\VirtualController) in File Explorer, containing saved profiles, device settings, and log files.
update_dialog.title: Update available
update_dialog.message: A new version of the app is available.
update_dialog.restarting: The app will restart now. This may take a moment.
rollback.title: Change version
rollback.message: Choose a version to switch to. This also works for older versions (rollback).
assign.title: Assign physical input
assign.search_tooltip: Search by input or device name
benchmark.no_measurements: No measurements yet. Start the benchmark above to see metrics update here.
benchmark.latency_title: Latency jitter (estimate relative to nominal USB interval)
benchmark.latency_unavailable: Unavailable (nominal USB polling interval is unknown).
benchmark.hid_multiple_warning: Multiple HID interfaces with the same vendor/product ID were found. If no samples arrive while the device is active, the wrong interface may have been opened (see the highlighted entry below).
